_notes: Single source of truth for the ProfessionalService JSON-LD injected into every page. Edit this file, then re-run `python3 scripts/generate_schema.py` to regenerate the schema block across all pages. Leave a field as an empty string if you don't have real data for it yet — the generator omits empty fields instead of publishing placeholder text as if it were real, since fake structured data is worse for trust/SEO than no data at all.
_todo_url: REQUIRED before this schema is fully valid: set `url` to the real live domain (e.g. https://www.velmuretech.com). Without it, `logo`/`image` are omitted entirely (schema.org requires an absolute URL for those, not a relative path) and canonical/og:url tags across the site still point at the https://velmuretech.example placeholder used during this SEO pass — search css/js grep for that string to find every place it needs swapping.
_todo_sameAs: Add every official profile that represents this same business once they exist/are confirmed: Google Business Profile URL, Facebook Page, Instagram, LinkedIn Company Page. This is one of the strongest signals for Google to recognize 'Velmure Tech' as a real, disambiguated entity (directly relevant to the brand-name-search problem) — an empty array here is a real gap, not just a nice-to-have.
